hook_text: Every birthday, you have travelled all the way around the Sun. How far did you go?
clip_script: Happy birthday, Naledi! You just finished your tenth trip around the Sun. Out on the playground: Naledi in the middle with the Sun sign. Around her: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Eight planets, all orbiting the Sun. One orbit of the Earth equals one year. My Very Easy Method Just Speeds Up Naming. Now you will never forget the order.
visual_style: Whiteboard playground with a learner in the centre holding a yellow Sun sign and eight learners walking in circles around her, each with a planet sign, then the real solar system drawn with the planets in order.
mood: Playful and energetic, like a game at break time that turns out to be science.
pacing: First the Earth's orbit and what a year is, then the Sun at the centre, then the eight planets in order.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and learn the order of the eight planets.
